notes.heading: Effective Date of Repeal
notes.effective_date: effective with respect to taxable years beginning after Dec.
notes.text: Repeal effective with respect to taxable years beginning after Dec. 31, 1967, except as provided by section 104 of Pub. L. 90–364, see section 103(f) of Pub. L. 90–364, set out as an Effective Date of 1968 Amendment note under section 243 of this title.
